notes: Version 2.45 records the I-3 correction in Foundation 2.6 and its consumers NIF-Note 1.6, Q6a 2.5, FM-Note 3.3, Q5a 3.3 and Q5b 2.3; the consumers no longer state that the admissibility axioms force irreducibility. Irreducibility of the admissible fibre follows from A1 and A3 and a representation-theoretic dictionary only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived, on which a generator-stable decomposition counts as premature selection. The discreteness of quantum transitions is postulated by A4, not derived: on the supplied Heisenberg shell realisation a realised saturation depth is an integer (O22), and the existence of such a depth is not established. The Projective Observability Principle is an adopted principle, not a consequence of A1-A4, and the physical reality of the proto-state and the revelation reading of the projection are interpretive readings. The white-paper entry states that the white paper proposes the substrate chi and the relaxation mechanism and that Foundation derives neither from A1-A4. The Foundation, NIF-Note, Q6a, FM-Note, Q5a and Q5b entries, table rows, graph nodes and bibliography notes are aligned.
